_readme: Provenance for every image a Royal Palm Beach blog article may reference. There is no verified Royal Palm Beach photography yet. Every image here is illustrative stock chosen by subject, not by place, and must be captioned as illustrative and never described as a Royal Palm Beach location. Enforced by scripts/audit-city-images.mjs (runs before every build).
